Comedian Overview

Jay Stevens has appeared on FOX, TBN, and TCT Network's Celebrate Live Detroit, and can regularly be heard on SiriusXM's clean comedy channels. He is also the star of the popular Dry Bar Comedy special Life Is Hilarious, which has earned millions of views and introduced his comedy to audiences worldwide. 

In addition to his success on stage, Jay has built a large online following through his viral comedy videos on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube. His comedy albums, Let's Talk About It and Life Is Hilarious, are available on major streaming platforms and showcase the same sharp observations and everyday humor that have made him a fan favorite.

Known for his relatable storytelling, quick wit, and high-energy stage presence, Jay Stevens has become one of the most sought-after clean comedians performing today. With more than 20 years of professional stand-up comedy experience, Jay has entertained audiences across the country in comedy clubs, casinos, theaters, churches, corporate events, and cruise ships. His ability to connect with audiences of all ages has made him a favorite among fans of both mainstream and family-friendly comedy.

Whether he's talking about family, relationships, work, or the absurdities of daily life, Jay Stevens delivers a comedy experience that is clean, relatable, and laugh-out-loud funny from start to finish.
